concepts.def: Ensuring everyone has enough safe food
Plants with a useful gene from another species
Dead/weak pathogen training the immune system

walkthroughs.body_html:
Demand for food rises as the population grows.

Strategies: selective breeding, GM crops, fertilisers, fish farming, hydroponics, reduced food waste.

Vaccines train the immune system to make memory cells.

Antibiotics kill bacteria. Overuse drives resistance — a growing global threat.

Conservation: protected areas, captive breeding, seed banks, sustainable fishing.

Threats: climate change, deforestation, pollution. Indicator species reveal habitat health.
